subject: Mutual action timeline — environment commission & security gate
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@storixhealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action timeline — environment commission & security gate

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great to see Storix's use cases mapped to our latencies and cost profile. As discussed, attached is a concise mutual action timeline we recommend to get a short evaluation (2-week POC) into a production-ready tenant. The spreadsheet breaks the work into three lanes: Admin (org + billing), Security (IP allowlist, KMS, audit), and Network (VPC peering, routing).

Key asks to unblock the timeline:
- Confirmation of the tenant admin email for org bootstrapping (we need a single owner to issue API keys).
- IP allowlist window: which /32s can your security team add to complete verification?
- Preferred VPC peering window (we can peer in us-west-2 or us-east-1) and a point of contact for peering details.

I've tentatively scheduled the handoff week starting June 14 in the sheet. Naomi (CC) will own the credentialing steps; Karthik will triage routing and peering. Please flag any hard constraints.

Attachments: RDW-Storix-MAP-2027-06-02.xlsx (MAP timeline), storix-network-sketch.png

Thanks,
Marcus
VP, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0194

Hi Marcus,

Appreciate the clear plan — this is helpful. A couple quick items from our side:
1) Tenant admin: use tenant-admin@storixhealth.com (me + one backup in our identity provider).
2) IP allowlist: we can open the allowlist for a verification window Mon 6/14 08:00–16:00 PT. The CIDRs we'll add for testing are: 34.82.45.11/32 and 18.209.77.54/32. Can you confirm these are the ephemeral egress addresses for your staging nodes?
3) VPC peering: we prefer us-west-2 — I'll loop in our infra lead if you need VPC IDs.

Procurement, please see tentative pricing in the draft we received and advise on PO routing.

—Emily

Emily, Marcus — quick technical clarifications from the security lane: 
- The two IPs listed match our staging egress nodes for the handoff. We will also provide a short-lived jumpbox IP (52.8.101.77/32) for in-situ checks; we can turn that on during your verification window only.
- Org setup: please add tenant-admin@storixhealth.com as the initial org admin in our onboarding portal (https://onboard.redwood.com/). Once added, the portal will allow you to request API keys; we provision scoped keys with TTLs for POC work.
- KMS: if you require customer-managed keys, we'll need the KMS ARN by June 10. Otherwise we'll use our default managed keys for the POC.

I'll attach a compact checklist snippet to the MAP (authentication, API-key steps, rotation policy).

Naomi Feldman
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@storixhealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action timeline — environment commission & security gate

Emily — quick note from the network side. For VPC peering we'll need the following to prepare the routing and security groups:
- Your VPC ID (vpc-0a1b2c3d4e), region (you said us-west-2), and the desired subnet list for peering.
- Confirmation whether you want full-route propagation or a more restricted prefix list (recommended for production; POC can use full route for speed).
- Expected test window for peering acceptance — we can complete the handshake in ~2 hours once both sides create peering requests and share route tables.

If you prefer, we can switch the peering step to a temporary NAT/proxy for the POC to avoid long-running peering approvals. Happy to run whichever path shortens your security review.

Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Emily Park <emily@storixhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual action timeline — environment commission & security gate

Thanks all — this works. Quick updates:
- Procurement has approved a trial PO and attached the signed version for your records (signed-po-storix-0627.pdf).
- VPC ID: vpc-07e9b2c3 (us-west-2). We'll start with a temporary proxy for the first 48 hours to speed acceptance, then follow up with a peering request week of 6/21.
- KMS: we'll stick with Redwood-managed keys for the POC. If the POC moves to a pilot, we'll request a customer KMS ARN.
- IP allowlist: we added the two /32s you provided; Naomi, please confirm connectivity when your jumpbox is enabled on 6/14.

I'll leave tenant-admin@storixhealth.com as the org admin in the portal later today. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Emily
Head of Platform Ops — Storix Health
